description.stringValue: Wood-fired pizzas, hand-made pastas and a dessert counter worth saving room for. Sourdough is proofed for 48 hours.
Wild mushrooms, truffle cream, mozzarella and a thyme oil drizzle on a thin crust.
Slow-simmered San Marzano tomato, garlic, chilli and basil. Vegetarian.
Grilled chicken, basil pesto, cherry tomatoes and parmesan tossed in penne.
Classic cream and parmesan sauce with fresh cracked pepper.
Espresso-soaked savoiardi, mascarpone cream and cocoa. Made fresh every morning.
North Indian classics done properly — hand-ground masalas, slow-cooked curries and oven-fired naan.
Tandoori chicken in a rich tomato and cashew gravy finished with white butter.
Soft paneer cubes in a mildly sweet tomato gravy with a cream swirl.
Black urad simmered overnight on low coals with butter and cream.
Sealed-pot biryani with long-grain basmati, saffron and fried onions.
Tandoor-baked, brushed with garlic butter and coriander.
Indo-Chinese wok dishes with a proper flame. Everything is tossed to order, so it arrives hot.
Wok-tossed noodles with charred garlic, spring onion and a dark soy glaze.
Crisp fried chicken with curry leaf, red chilli and a squeeze of lime.
Soft paneer tossed with garlic, green chilli and spring onion.
Golden-fried vegetable dumplings in a mildly spicy soy glaze.
Smash burgers and loaded fries. The patties are pressed to order — expect a short wait.
Double smashed beef, American cheese, pickles and house sauce in a brioche bun.
Buttermilk-brined fried chicken, slaw and chipotle mayo.
Griddled mushrooms, melted Swiss and truffle aioli. Vegetarian.
Skin-on fries, molten cheese sauce, jalapeños and spring onion.
South Indian filter coffee, crisp dosas and idlis batter fermented the traditional way.
Crisp rice and urad dosa with potato palya, coconut chutney and sambar.
Paper-thin dosa brushed with cow ghee and served with podi chutney.
Two steamed idlis and a golden medu vada with chutney and sambar.
Classic decoction and boiled milk poured between tumbler and davara.
Grain bowls, salads and cold-press juice. Mostly plant-based, with a few protein add-ons.
Quinoa, roasted pumpkin, avocado, chickpeas, feta and a lemon tahini dressing.
Romaine, shaved parmesan, croutons and grilled chicken breast.
Spinach, cucumber, green apple, ginger and lemon. No added sugar.
